mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_tool_execution (execution_id, user_id, conversation_id, tool, args_hash, args_json, status, attempt_count, started_at) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{tool}, #{argsHash}, #{argsJson}, 'RUNNING', 1, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, execution_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO ai_tool_execution (execution_id, user_id, conversation_id, tool, args_hash, args_json, summary, risk, expires_at, status) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{tool}, #{argsHash}, #{argsJson}, #{summary}, #{risk}, #{expiresAt}, 'PENDING') ON CONFLICT (user_id, execution_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_tool_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', args_hash = COALESCE(args_hash, #{argsHash}), args_json = COALESCE(#{argsJson}, args_json), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = now(), finished_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND execution_id = #{executionId} AND ( status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'FAILED') OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < now() - make_interval(secs => #{staleSeconds})) )
